title: Gardeners' Guild
description:
Gardeners' Guild is a full-service landscaping company based in the SF Bay Area, specializing in both interior and exterior landscape maintenance and construction. Founded in 1972 and employee-owned, they offer a range of services including irrigation repair, sustainable landscaping, and fire fuel reduction. Their clients include multi-family communities, commercial buildings, business parks, hospitality venues, and residential properties. The company is dedicated to transforming and maintaining landscapes while promoting water conservation and drought-tolerant designs. 
The company headquarters is located in 2780 Goodrick Avenue, Richmond, CA 94801, United States.
51-200 Employees
